Despite how it looks, only one of its attacks is lightning damage, which makes a Yellow Ring or NulShock Ring less useful than it sounds. Ixion BOSS BATTLE Be sure to Steal or Mug Ixion’s Sprint Shoes before the fight ends. Ixion follows a clear pattern. It casts Aerospark, which takes 62.5% of a girl’s current HP; it then recharges, healing some of its HP; then it casts Thor’s Hammer. Thor’s Hammer hurts your party quite a bit (about 700), so have everyone healed before it lands. Ixion absorbs lightning damage but is weak to water: Water, Watera, Waterga, Liquid Steel, or Water Gems made with Mix. Ixion, unlike Yojimbo, can be hit by Warrior Break abilities, which are useful if the fight drags on.

watch.firstLine: Where the fayth stood, there's only a hole.

lines: Where the fayth stood, there's only a hole.
Don't lean over it. Please don't lean over it.
Behind you!
Ixion rises and charges. Rikku and Paine leap aside.
I fell a long way. Everything was white.
I woke in the Songstress dress. The Farplane.
Someone walked out of the fog. For a moment it was him.
Lenne.
It's me. Shuyin. I couldn't protect you.
This world failed us. Vegnagun will end it.
He held me, and I could not move at all.
The love I felt was not mine. It was hers.
Let her go!
Baralai. We know you are in there.
The face changed. It was never him. It was Baralai.
Baralai turns and walks deeper into the Farplane.
Two spheres. They belong to Paine.
We'll bring him back.
Take care of things topside.
I'm all alone.
(Whistle)
A small gold light answers.
(Whistle)
The light comes nearer.
(Whistle)
It waits for her now.
(Whistle)
I woke in the Bevelle Underground, where Vegnagun had been.
Two spheres in my hands, and somebody had answered.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Gippal's missing, and his temple's full of fiends.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: They're pouring out of the top. The Chamber.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: The Chamber of the Fayth. That's Ixion's.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: This can't be happening.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Where the fayth stood, there's only a hole.

dboxTimeline.text: Behind you!
Ixion rises and charges. Rikku and Paine leap aside.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Yunie!
I fell a long way. Everything was white.
I woke in the Songstress dress. The Farplane.
Someone walked out of the fog. For a moment it was him.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: Lenne.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: It's me. Shuyin. I couldn't protect you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Shuyin
dboxTimeline.text: This world failed us. Vegnagun will end it.
He held me, and I could not move at all.
The love I felt was not mine. It was hers.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Gippal
dboxTimeline.text: Let her go!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Nooj
dboxTimeline.text: Baralai. We know you are in there.
The face changed. It was never him. It was Baralai.
Baralai turns and walks deeper into the Farplane.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Gippal
dboxTimeline.text: Two spheres. They belong to Paine.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Nooj
dboxTimeline.text: We'll bring him back.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Gippal
dboxTimeline.text: Take care of things topside.
They follow him down, and the fog closes.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: I'm all alone.
(Whistle)
A small gold light answers.
(Whistle)
The light comes nearer.
(Whistle)
It waits for her now.
(Whistle)
It runs ahead, over a bridge of light.
I woke in the Bevelle Underground, where Vegnagun had been.
Two spheres in my hands, and somebody had answered.
